title: Evaluation on any open normalized by the ordinary sections unit
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and U any open of Spec(A). Use the chosen derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category] on Spec(A), its over-opens, U and A-modules. Let O=Q(tilde(extended A[0])) from [def-sc-koszul-open-system], R the derived over-restriction followed by the over-equivalence, G=R(affineOpenSections A U) from [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total], and H=H^0. Construct the ordinary unit class s_U by mapping 1 from H^0(extended A[0]) through the termwise tilde.toOpen map. Let z_U be its image through homologyFunctorFactors and the ordinary-to-derived sections unit (quotientCompQhIso, rightDerivedFunctorUnit, quotientCompQhIso). There is a family b_E:Hom(R(O),R(E)) equiv H(G(E)), natural for every derived postcomposition, with b_O(id)=z_U. No finite cover, Koszul class, inverse augmentation, boundedness or quasi-coherence assumption is used.

source.place: First paragraph, structure-sheaf specialization; Tag 06Z0, sections adjunction; Tag 08BS, restriction of K-injectives

proof.text: Identify the restriction of tilde(A[0]) with O_U[0]. On a K-injective representative J, evaluation at one sends a chain map O_U[0] to J to a degree-zero global cycle; its inverse multiplies that cycle by local sections of O_U. Homotopies correspond exactly to boundaries. Quotienting therefore yields the canonical structure-sheaf Hom/hypercohomology equivalence of [lem-pc-derived-structure-sheaf-hom-hypercohomology], retaining the cycle description for the normalization below.

Open restriction preserves K-injectives by its exact left adjoint extension by zero [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. The over-equivalence does likewise. Restrict an ambient K-injective resolution to U. Its global sections, after exact scalar restriction along A to Gamma(U,O_U), are exactly the affineOpenSections complex. Comparing the localization and derived-functor units gives H(G(E)) in the specified universe. Evaluation and all these comparisons commute with postcomposition by maps of K-injective representatives, which descend to every derived arrow.

The structure identity evaluates to 1 before resolution. The ordinary class of its restriction is the explicitly constructed openStructureUnitClass: extendHomologyIso and singleObjHomologySelfIso identify the class of 1, and tilde.toOpen restricts it. Naturality of the derived-functor unit with the resolution sends this class to derivedOpenStructureUnit, proving b_O(id)=z_U. Empty U has zero section and Hom groups; the zero ring and all universes use the same comparison isos. This normalization is established from the cycle construction, not inferred from an arbitrary existential equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedOpenStructure_evaluation_unit
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A U).rightDerivedFunctor
    ∃ b : ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)),
      (R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E) ≃ H.obj (G.obj E),
      (∀ (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) (g : E ⟶ E')
        (ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E),
        b E' (ψ ≫ R.map g) = H.map (G.map g) (b E ψ)) ∧
      b (koszulOpenStructure A) (𝟙 _) = derivedOpenStructureUnit A U
